Dion Francis DiMucci (born July 18, 1939), better known mononymously as Dion, is an American singer and songwriter.
His music incorporates elements of doo-wop, pop, rock, R&B, folk and blues.
Initially the lead singer of the vocal group Dion and the Belmonts, Dion embarked on a solo career, and was one of the most prominent rock and roll performers of the pre-British Invasion era.
